 Right Arrow Opinion CA POST EDITORIAL BOARD: Vote Hilton for California governor over establishment hack Becerra for real change
 The Republican has introduced new ideas that even some Democrats have embraced. Becerra is simply an empty suit
 By
 California Post Editorial Board California Post 
 Published
 October 29, 2026 9:14am EDT
 | 
 Updated
 October 29, 2026 9:16am EDT Comments

 close Video Steve Hilton warns of DSA takeover in California, targets homeless and drug crisis 
 Steve Hilton, a California gubernatorial candidate, joins 'Fox & Friends' to discuss the state's escalating homeless and drug crises. Hilton warns of a potential Democratic Socialists of America takeover and criticizes opponent Xavier Becerra. He argues that the current policies are failing California residents and calls for urgent reform in the state's leadership ahead of the election.
 NEW You can now listen to Fox News articles!
 The California Post endorses Steve Hilton for governor.
 Hilton has run an impressive and bold campaign.
 The Republican has introduced new ideas that even some Democrats have embraced, like allowing Californians to pay no taxes on income up to $150,000.
 STEVE HILTON BLASTS DEMOCRATS FOR MAKING CALIFORNIA UNAFFORDABLE AFTER 16 YEARS OF UNCHECKED POWER 
 He has also urged California to lower fuel prices by getting rid of high gas taxes and the costly "green energy" policies that add massive costs to household budgets without doing anything for the planet.
 On housing, Hilton has urged California to build out, not up, returning to the single-family homes that people want — not ugly high-rises.
 STEVE HILTON LAUNCHES AD MOCKING XAVIER BECERRA'S '36 YEARS' AS A CAREER POLITICIAN IN CALIFORNIA GOV RACE 
 And Hilton has stood up to the madness on the transgender issue, defending the rights of girls in sports and the rights of parents to know what is going on with their children.
 Video Despite the odds stacked against him, Hilton has worked tirelessly across the state, even going to Skid Row and "fentanyl alley" to show the consequences of decades of bad policy in Sacramento.
 BLUE STATE SCHOOL DISTRICT ACCUSED OF DEFYING SUPREME COURT, HIDING GENDER TRANSITIONS FROM PARENTS 
 His opponent, Democrat Xavier Becerra , was nobody’s first choice in the primary. Even former Obama administration staffers were appalled that he might move ahead to the general election.
 Close Obama advisor Susan Rice once called Becerra an idiot, a remark she did not deny even when backing her party’s nominee.
 $104,200 SALARY IN ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA CONSIDERED 'LOW-INCOME' BY STATE OFFICIALS 
 Becerra is simply an empty suit. He has failed upwards his entire political career.
 Video Becerra was a do-nothing congressman in Washington. Then he became California’s attorney general when Kamala Harris left, despite his dormant law license. He was invisible as Joe Biden’s HHS secretary, and has no real achievements to speak of, despite decades of involvement in politics.
 TRUMP-BACKED HILTON ADVANCES TO CALIFORNIA GOVERNOR GENERAL ELECTION 
 The stakes could not be higher. The California dream is falling apart.
 California gubernatorial candidate Xavier Becerra speaks during an election night event Tuesday, June 2, 2026, in Los Angeles. (Jae C. Hong/AP Photo) 
 Yes, we still have the fourth-biggest economy in the world. But we also lead the nation in poverty and homelessness .
 HOUSING FIRST IS A DISASTER. I SAW SACRAMENTO'S HOMELESS CHAOS FIRSTHAND 
 Businesses that started here are leaving the state, taking jobs with them. That’s especially true in Hollywood, which is losing tens of thousands of jobs.
 For 16 years, Democrats have done whatever they wanted to in California, and the results are a disaster.
 CEO SAYS DOING BUSINESS IN STATE ‘SUCKS’ AS COMPANY HEADS TO TEXAS AMID CALIFORNIA EXODUS 
 We have watched the California dream being trampled by the politics of extremism, envy and division. Our big cities have been trashed by rioters. And now socialists want to take over.
 Video While our politicians lecture us about climate change, they allow hundreds of thousands of acres to burn in wildfires every year, erasing all the gains in emissions, and causing untold misery to tens of thousands of homeowners.
 Fraud is rampant throughout our government programs, even as spending is out of control.
 CLICK HERE FOR MORE FOX NEWS OPINION 
 Our infrastructure is crumbling, our schools are failing and nobody in Sacramento seems to want to do anything about it.
 We are seeing the results of nearly two decades of one-party misrule. And the Democrats have given us a candidate who promises to change nothing.
 CLICK HERE TO DOWNLOAD THE FOX NEWS APP 
 As Becerra said during the recent debate: the definition of insanity is doing the same thing over again and expecting a different result.
 This year, California voters have a real choice.
